cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,subprocess,resource,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import process_guard
def pre():
    for which,values in [
        (resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(180,181)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(256,256)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NPROC,(64,64)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE,(64*1024**2,64*1024**2)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_STACK,(8*1024**2,8*1024**2)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_MEMLOCK,(65536,65536)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_MSGQUEUE,(819200,819200)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_SIGPENDING,(4096,4096)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_NICE,(0,0)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_RTPRIO,(0,0)),
    ]: resource.setrlimit(which,values)
    process_guard.restrict_child()
outbin='/workspace/tmp/filter-engine'
p=subprocess.Popen(['g++','-O2','-std=c++17','/workspace/submission/engine.cpp','-o',outbin],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,preexec_fn=pre)
o,e=p.communicate(timeout=120);print('compile rc',p.returncode,e[:200]);assert p.returncode==0
import glob
for fn in sorted(glob.glob('examples/*.in.native')):
    exp=fn.replace('.in.native','.out.native')
    p=subprocess.Popen([outbin],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,preexec_fn=pre)
    o,e=p.communicate(open(fn,'rb').read(),timeout=120)
    a=open(exp,'rb').read().split();b=o.split();print(fn,'rc',p.returncode,'match',a==b,'err',e[:100]);assert p.returncode==0 and a==b
print('NATIVE FULL FILTER PASS')
